Ch. 2. 7</ls>. .³({%b%}) A cloud. .²3 A divine man, Brāhmaṇa, as in भूदेव. .²4 A king, ruler, as in मनुष्यदेव; तां देवसमितिं (अभ्यागच्छत्) <ls>Mb. 3. 130. 22</ls>. .²5 A title affixed to the names of Bārhmaṇas; as in गोविन्ददेव, पुरुषोत्तमदेव <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 (In dramas) A title of honour used in addressing a king, (‘My lord’, ‘Your majesty’); ततश्च देव <ls>Ve. 4</ls>; यथाज्ञापयति देवः <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Quicksilver. .²8 The Supreme Spirit; हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति देवं दिवौकसो द्यामिव पार्थ सांख्याः <ls>Mb. 12. 301. 112</ls>. .²9 A fool .²10 A child. .²11 A man following any particular business. .²12 A lover. .²13 Emulation. .²14 Sport, play. .²15 A husbandʼs brother (<ab>cf.</ab> देवृ, देवर). .²16 A lancer. .{@-वम्@} An organ of sense; देवानां प्रभवो देवो मनसश्च त्रिलोककृत् <ls>Mb. 14. 41. 3</ls>. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%deus%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%deos%}].

देवी .²1 A female deity, a goddess. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Sarasvatī. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Sāvitrī. .²5 A queen, especially a crowned queen (अग्रमहिषी who has undergone the consecration along with her husband); प्रेष्यभावेन नामेयं देवीशब्दक्षमा सती . स्नायीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्त्रोर्णं वोपयुज्यते <ls>M. 5. 12</ls>; देवीभावं गमिता परिवारपदं कथं भजत्येषा <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .²6 A respectful title applied to a lady of the first rank. .²7 A kind of bird (श्यामा). .²8 A particular supernatural power (कुण्डलिनी).
